Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the partnership this year. We're approaching our renewal window and would like to lock a Renewal QBR that includes a 45-minute roadmap demo (product direction + relevant performance notes) and a 60-minute technical deep-dive for our engineering and infra teams.

High-level asks:
- Roadmap demo (45m) with time for Q&A
- Technical deep-dive (60m) to review caching/batching recommendations and SLA expectations
- Exec presence from both sides for the first 15 minutes

Our preferred date range is Aug 4–8; timezone PST. Our procurement lead (Priya Rao) may need to be looped for a brief contract/status check after the QBR. I attached a draft agenda (Novum-Agenda-v1.pdf).

Can you propose a few time windows and owners? If you have a condensed run-of-show template, that would help us coordinate stakeholders.

Thanks,
Liam

Novum Health
